changeSummary: Models New York State methods and the NYC and Yonkers obligations as parented calculation jurisdictions with exclusive variants.

businessRules.description: State, NYC resident, Yonkers resident, and Yonkers nonresident are independent additive obligations.
Only one calculation variant in an exclusive group may apply to an employee payment.

Use the printed Method II table rate and base amount, rounding the variable-rate product to cents away from zero. The publication's two inconsistent semimonthly examples are treated as agency publication errors rather than overrides of the tables.
